title: Design System: FYI — Who Gets an Answer?

display.purpose: Cover title, numbered headings, card headers, team names.

body.purpose: Body prose, bold underlined links, labels, controls.

label.purpose: Tabular timestamps, sample badges, p-values, stamps, axes.

motion.name: duration-multiplier
motion.purpose: Governs scrolly SVG stroke-dashoffset, stamp landings, and button transitions.

motion.name: ease-mechanical
motion.purpose: Crisp deceleration for routing line draw and stamp lock-in.

components.name: Primary Orange CTA Button
components.description: Rounded-3px Signal Orange primary button on bond-paper ground.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; background: #F46201; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #F46201; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

components.name: Cobalt Tint Selector Tile
components.description: Agency selector button in cobalt tint transitioning to deep cobalt hover/active.
components.css: .ds-tile { padding: 0.78rem 0.85rem; background: #EFF4FD; color: #1c1246; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'Source Serif 4', serif; font-weight: 700; }
